about: Formats without secrets in the core (docs/CORE_UNIFICATION.md U6): normalize_username and split_for_push answers of the desktop's sezam.usernames / sync_limits before they moved (Unicode 14.0.0). split_for_push takes the bytes each object takes in the request. aad and padded_size: cross_client.json and padding.json. state_hash: the desktop's compute_state_hash / legacy_state_hash answers before they moved, inputs with SHA-256 of the payload.
